Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

exploreDE 3.10.0

  • The version follows Bioconductor’s numbering, where an even middle number marks a release.
  • anndataR is installed from Bioconductor: the DESCRIPTION no longer has a Remotes: field pointing to GitHub. exploreDE needs anndataR >= 1.3, which Bioconductor ships from release 3.24; until then, install anndataR from GitHub (scverse/anndataR) yourself.
  • The demo dataset (inst/examples/genomics/deResult.rds) is 4.4 MB instead of 34 MB. It shows the same samples, features, DE table and ORA/GSEA results; removed are parts the app never reads: the DESeq2 object, the gene sets of GO terms that are in no result table, and duplicate annotation columns. inst/scripts/trim_demo_deResult.R records the trimming.
  • Every exported function and class has a help-page example that runs on the shipped example datasets, and says what it returns. The DESCRIPTION gives the package’s URL, bug tracker, Bioconductor categories, and the maintainer’s ORCID.
  • exploreDE has a hex sticker (man/figures/logo.png, drawn by inst/scripts/make_hex_logo.R): a volcano plot whose point density draws a cat face. The README opens with what exploreDE is and says to install anndataR from GitHub first.
  • The hex sticker now has dotted cat eyes, ears and whiskers, a background-coloured mouth, and subdued grey “re” lettering. The README links the sticker to the full-size PNG.
  • Documentation website at https://fgcz.github.io/exploreDE/ (pkgdown): the README, the help pages, the bring-your-own-data vignette and this changelog, rebuilt on every push to main.
  • Help pages show code and links as such: backticks and [function()] references in the documentation were printed literally before.
  • ExploreDataset objects print the same summary as before, now from a format() method: format(eds) returns its lines, and the eds$print() method is gone (print(eds) works as before).

exploreDE 3.9.0

Breaking changes

  • Saved sessions are .json only (format exploreDE-session/2). The .rds session format is removed: An uploaded .rds is refused with a message asking the user to save again as .json. Reading an .rds can run code; reading JSON can’t. Save / Load Session is out of beta.
  • Only the documented API is exported: exploreDE(), build_explore_h5ad(), new_explore_dataset(), validate_explore_dataset(), and the ExploreDataset* classes. The 89 app helpers (generateParams(), step_*(), banana_*(), save_state_*(), …) are internal, so exploreDE::<helper>() no longer works; the app gets them by sourcing R/ or, when installed, from the package namespace.

New features

  • Open an .h5ad from a link: ?data=<percent-encoded https URL>, from an allowed source (APB Export jobs and public pStore by default; set EXPLOREDE_URL_SOURCES to change them). Plain https:// only, no redirects, up to 1 GB, then the same checks as an upload.
  • JSON session files also save and restore the Multi DE datasets, in order, with their settings.
  • Per-tab contrast selectors throughout the app, kept in sync.
  • .h5ad DE tables can say which features entered the test: Optional used_in_test column (spec §5). build_explore_h5ad() picks up a usedInTest / used_in_test column from the DE table through the column dictionary, so files built from SUSHI results show the same tested features as the SUSHI original. Without it, “tested” still means a non-NA p-value.
  • Reads the prolfquapp DEA’s AnnData.h5ad and prolfquapp ≥ 2.10 SummarizedExperiment results.
  • Container RAM/CPU badge in the header.
  • GO behaves like KEGG: The GO parts of the app (tile plot selector, heatmap GO sub-tab) appear only when the features carry GO annotation columns, and any subset of GO BP / GO MF / GO CC works. The Pathway Tile Plots tab shows when GO annotation or a supported KEGG species is available, so human/mouse/rat data without GO columns now get KEGG tiles. New exported helpers go_annotation_columns() and features_in_go_term().

Bug fixes

  • An .h5ad without uns["de"] loads as counts-only; before, uns$de partial-matched uns$design and the file failed to load. Pathway tables are read with [[ for the same reason.
  • Multi DE: Dataset paths outside the data roots (or containing ..) are refused, and each dataset gets its own LDAP project check.
  • An empty feature bucket no longer prints “display:none;”.
  • GO tile plots and the GO heatmap work on .h5ad files: GO membership is read from the features, not the DE table (which .h5ad files don’t give GO columns). Before, they failed with “object ‘GO BP’ not found”.
  • GO tile plots skip features without a log2 fold change and draw no stars for an NA p-value, instead of failing (“NA/NaN/Inf in foreign function call”, “missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed”).
  • GO tabs follow the changed twoGroups output of ezRun; small ORA/GSEA and volcano fixes.
  • rhdf5 is a declared dependency, so .h5ad files load on a fresh install; before, anndataR failed with “HDF5AnnData requires the rhdf5 package”.
  • The app gets the package’s functions, internal helpers included, when it runs from the installed package, however it is started (exploreDE::exploreDE(), or shiny::runApp() on system.file("app", package = "exploreDE")). Before, it needed library(exploreDE) first (‘could not find function “legend_offset_ui”’), and internal helpers such as the prolfquapp .h5ad reader were never available.
  • The ORA and GSEA tabs keep their settings apart. Before, for an uploaded .h5ad, the GSEA tab overwrote the ORA FDR threshold, and the ORA table failed with “length(cuts) must be equal to length(values) - 1”.
  • The Volcano and DE Table tabs work for an .h5ad whose features have no description column (the description falls back to the gene name, as for SUSHI results). Before, the volcano failed with “undefined columns selected”.
  • Species without KEGG support (anything but human, mouse and rat): Changing the contrast no longer ends the session with “EXPR must be a length 1 vector”. An .h5ad with two or more contrasts hung on load.
  • Level labels with Greek letters, or with a space between two tags, keep their formatting when a PDF device is open on Linux. Before, the label check measured them on that device, failed, and fell back to plain text.

Documentation

  • Written format specs in inst/spec/: exploreDE-h5ad-1.0.md (the .h5ad layout, proteomics profile including precursor level, prolfquapp dialects, and a minimal Python writer) and exploreDE-session-2.md (session files).
  • README, the bring-your-own-data vignette, and the AI skill now cover writing files outside R, opening files from a link, and saving sessions.
  • The help pages of the ExploreDataset* classes describe every public method and its arguments.

Removed

  • The App Data tab (deprecated).
  • devtools as a dependency: installing exploreDE no longer installs it. dendextend and rlang, which the package code calls, move from Suggests to Imports.

exploreDE 3.8.0

  • Project Jambon: One column dictionary with ordered patterns; enrichment rebuilt from tidy tables on load; build_explore_h5ad() documented in the bring-your-own-data vignette and an AI skill; exploreDE(file) opens a file directly, and the demo ships with the package; ezRun dropped.
  • Level labels, heatmap legend sliders, feature bucket fixes, and “DEG” → “DE” throughout the interface.
